handoff.context: Caller wants a human agent; was qualifying for father aged 71.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Meera calling from Niva Bupa. I'm reaching out about health cover for you and your family — is now a good time for a quick chat?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. To start, who are you looking to get covered — just yourself, or your family too?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks — so it's for your father, aged 71. What city is he based in?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Actually, I'd rather just speak to a real person about this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course — I'll get a colleague to call you back. Is this the best number to reach you on?
